node.title: Re: Perl regex txt file new line (not recognised?)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I can confirm that your code works fine for me on Linux when the input file has LF line endings, but not when it has CRLF line endings. So I am guessing that is the problem, to confirm, see the [id://745674] and use e.g. [doc://Data::Dumper] with $Data::Dumper::Useqq=1; turned on. If CRLF is indeed the issue, there are a couple of ways to fix this: You could add the :crlf [doc://PerlIO] layer when reading the files, as in open (IN,'<:raw:encoding(UTF-8):crlf', $file) (note I added the :raw as technically, the CRLF conversion should happen after the decoding, although that shouldn't really be a problem with UTF-8 I believe); you could convert the files before processing using e.g. fromdos from [https://www.thefreecountry.com/tofrodos/index.shtml|Tofrodos]; or you could change the regex to adapt, as in s/^[a-z].*[a-z]\r?$//gmi (wouldn't be my preferred solution, but TIMTOWTDI).
